status: not validated with annotators; no kappa exists

scale.note: 1-5 ordinal. Anchors are deliberately terse; see docs/rubric/annotation-rubric.md for the long form and the known problems.

dimensions.name: Attention Fragmentation
dimensions.description: How fast the video cuts, and whether any shot is allowed to breathe.

anchors.1: Long, stable shots; a sustained argument.
anchors.5: Cut every 1-2 s, zoom-punches, no dwell.

dimensions.name: Substance Deficit
dimensions.description: Whether the video adds information beyond restating its title.

anchors.5: Restates the title, no new information, circular.

dimensions.name: Narration Origin
dimensions.description: Human or machine voice. The dimension most likely to fail as TTS improves.

anchors.1: Clearly human: disfluencies, breaths, variable pause length.
anchors.3: Ambiguous: heavy processing, or an unusually polished human.
anchors.5: Clearly synthetic: flat prosody, no breaths, uniform pauses.

dimensions.name: Epistemic Reliability
dimensions.description: Checkability and honesty of the claims. Requires domain knowledge; expect low agreement.

adjudication.trigger: delta >= 2 on any dimension, or opposite harm_proxy_label
